Bathing a cat is generally not necessary because cats are excellent self-groomers and can keep themselves clean [d3, d4, d9, d10]. However, there are specific situations where a bath may be needed, such as if the cat gets into something toxic or sticky [d1, d8, d11], has a skin condition requiring medicated treatment [d5, d10], or is unable to groom itself due to age, obesity, or arthritis [d5, d10, d11].
